items: With several providers, a match plays from the one on show when it has it; the others are the fallback.
Feeds from your other providers say which provider they're from.
With Plus, your other providers' channels and guides are kept up to date in the background.

description: Find the match. Fix the stream. Keep watching. Amaviro is a TV player for iPhone, iPad, Mac and Apple TV that finds the channel showing your game and sorts out what goes wrong, on the TV service you already pay for.
